agent_responses.message: Hi, you've reached Brightside Home Care. I'm an AI assistant, not a person, and this call is recorded as a text transcript. You can talk to me in English, Spanish or Russian. How can I help you today?
Hi, I'm calling about the home health aide job I saw advertised.
Great. First, what's your first and last name? Please spell it for me.
It's Maria Rodriguez. That's M-A-R-I-A R-O-D-R-I-G-U-E-Z.
That's M-A-R-I-A, R-O-D-R-I-G-U-E-Z — is that right?
Yes, that's right.
Is the number you're calling from, ending in zero one two three, the best number for you?
Yes, it is.
Thanks. Now a few quick questions — about three minutes. Do you have a current New York home health aide or personal care aide certificate — HHA or PCA?
Yes, I do. I have a New York HHA certificate.
Are you legally authorized to work in the United States?
Yes, I am.
Which neighborhood do you live in?
I live in Bensonhurst.
And your ZIP code?
Our clients are in Brooklyn and Queens. Can you get to clients there — by subway, bus or car?
I can travel by subway to Brooklyn and Queens.
Which days of the week can you work, and what hours?
I can work Monday to Friday, from 8 AM to 4 PM.
What languages do you speak?
I speak English and Spanish.
How many years have you worked as an aide?
I have 3 years of experience.
You meet our basic requirements. Let's book an interview at our office — it takes about thirty minutes. Do you have an email address for the confirmation?
No, I don't have an email.
Can we text you a reminder about your interview? Message and data rates may apply, and you can reply STOP at any time.
Yes, that's fine.
We have an opening on Thursday, October first at ten AM, Thursday, October first at two thirty PM, or Friday, October second at eleven AM. Which of those works for you?
Thursday at 2:30 PM works for me.
So that's Thursday, October first at two thirty PM at our office in Brooklyn. Shall I book it?
Yes, please book it.

Just a second…. You're booked for Thursday, October first at two thirty PM. Please bring your HHA or PCA certificate and a photo ID. The address is four fifty Brightside Avenue, Suite three, in Brooklyn. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Alright, got it. Thanks, goodbye.
Thank you for calling Brightside Home Care. Goodbye.
